learned.claim: v0.6.9: GRC layer complete - four heads (AI, Data, CISO, Risk) govern above the gates via G1 co-sign and registers; policy and enforcement never share a hat; acceptances are human signature + expiry.
Deliberate non-roles recorded in the standard: no head-of-compliance above compliance-officer, no separate cybersecurity role - a title without distinct authority is ceremony.
User-spotted craft gap closed: G0 and G1 finally have playbooks (requirements.md, architecture.md) - every gate now has its craft, not just its role and template.
